basics.name: Matt Grayling
basics.label: Astrophysicist | Supernova Cosmologist | Bayesian Statistician
basics.summary: I am a postdoctoral researcher specializing in Type Ia supernovae and their application to precision cosmology. My work focuses on developing GPU-accelerated hierarchical Bayesian models to extract robust cosmological constraints from large-scale supernova surveys. I lead the development of BayeSN, a next-generation framework that explicitly separates dust extinction from intrinsic supernova properties, and serve as Lead of the SN Ia Modelling Topical Team within the Dark Energy Science Collaboration, preparing for the Vera C. Rubin Observatory era.
